verdict.rationale: Splitting a sale across payment methods or payers is a fair question for an in-person payments product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents split-tender or multi-payer checkout. The cited features cover tipping, offline payments, receipts, refunds, and Connect for moving money between accounts, none of which is the same as splitting one sale.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can split a single sale across multiple payment methods or payers
